tiers.label: Runtime authority
tiers.completionPolicy: Complete only after canonical runtime, home silence, Firebase boundaries, and release-gate output are recorded in EVIDENCE.md.

tiers.label: System governance
tiers.completionPolicy: Complete only after required systems and mapped runtime paths are checked in CI and captured as artifact evidence.

tiers.label: Feature and route governance
tiers.completionPolicy: Complete only after route, feature, interaction, accessibility, and recovery coverage are checked in CI and captured as artifact evidence.

tiers.label: Implementation governance
tiers.completionPolicy: Complete only after route integrity, reduced motion, Firebase boundaries, env readiness, typecheck, and build evidence are captured.

tiers.label: Operational release governance
tiers.completionPolicy: Complete only after CI, artifact upload, rollback/incident readiness, release reporting, and live-check evidence are all recorded.

xrTargets.label: Web spatial runtime
xrTargets.claimPolicy: May be claimed live only after deployed URL smoke and EVIDENCE.md route/API rows are filled.

xrTargets.label: WebXR handheld/browser immersive surface
xrTargets.claimPolicy: Must remain disabled-until-provider-validated until permission, device, and smoke evidence are recorded.

xrTargets.label: Meta Quest VR target
xrTargets.claimPolicy: Cannot be claimed production-ready from web CI alone; requires device-lab evidence and release packet.

xrTargets.label: Apple visionOS spatial target
requiredEvidence: build artifact or app target evidence
xrTargets.claimPolicy: Cannot be claimed production-ready until a visionOS target exists and device/simulator evidence is recorded.

xrTargets.label: Handheld AR target
xrTargets.claimPolicy: Cannot be claimed production-ready until camera/session provider behavior is validated and privacy-reviewed.

externalReleaseBlockers: Deployed live URL and smoke evidence
XR provider/device-lab evidence for WebXR, Quest, visionOS, and handheld AR
Privacy/compliance signoff for provider-backed data flows
